_comment: DEEP-10M (96d L2, big-ann-benchmarks slice). Anchored on (recall, build_speed): pq_chunks=48 (2d/chunk) maximises PQ resolution within dim limit; l_build=200 needed for 10M-scale graph; num_threads=32 cuts wall-clock; build_ram_limit_gb=64 keeps the 10M (~3.8 GB raw) build in one shard. metric MUST be L2 to match the official big-ann GT.
